result.title: RSWP: Robust SO(3)-Equivariant Watermarking for Panoramic Images
result.summary: Robust watermarking for panoramic imagery is impeded by the topological mismatch between spherical signals and planar representations. Conventional methods fail under $SO(3)$ viewing rotations due to non-linear geometric warping and struggle with viewport extraction, which typically necessitates computationally expensive inverse remapping. To address these challenges, we propose RSWP, a watermarking framework grounded in icosahedral group theory. Leveraging the property that the icosahedral group ($\mathcal{I}_{60}$) serves as the largest discrete subgroup of $SO(3)$, we decompose spherical rotations into tractable local planar rotations and combinatorial facet permutations. Accordingly, we introduce a decoupling architecture that embeds watermarks into discrete facets and a theoretically guaranteed Equivariance-to-Invariance decoding paradigm. By employing an equivariant feature extractor followed by a permutation-invariant sorting module, this paradigm rigorously synchronizes rotation-distorted features. Moreover, the dual-extractor design inherently supports direct, blind watermark retrieval from partial 2D renderings without geometric calibration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSWP achieves state-of-the-art robustness against continuous $SO(3)$ rotations and viewport transformations while preserving high visual fidelity.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 RSWP，一个基于二十面体群（I₂₀）理论的球面全景图像水印框架：把 SO(3) 旋转分解为局部平面旋转与面片置换，将水印嵌入离散面片，并用「等变特征提取 + 置换不变排序」的解码范式实现无需几何标定的盲提取。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「等变编码—不变解码」的解耦结构可能为 LVR 中视觉证据在视角/置换变化下保持稳定表征提供可核查线索，但论文本身针对水印信号同步而非推理状态，迁移价值需人工判断。
